programme.title: Migration & Transfer Follow Along
programme.outcome: Plan and perform a small database full-load migration with AWS DMS, transfer the resulting objects with AWS DataSync, and build a concrete Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached-versus-stored configuration plan; verify each outcome and safely remove only the resources created by the lab.
programme.statusNotice: Offline authoring manuscript only — not locally validated, imported, accepted, approved, published or fingerprinted.
completionDefinition: A self-managed MariaDB source is launched with no inbound SSH and a runtime-generated Secrets Manager password.
DMS uses a two-AZ replication subnet group, a small replication instance, a Secrets Manager-authenticated source endpoint and an S3 target endpoint.
A full-load DMS task migrates three known rows into a private S3 bucket.
A DataSync task copies the migrated objects into a second private S3 bucket.
The learner creates a complete cached-versus-stored Volume Gateway design with cache, upload-buffer and iSCSI volume sizing.
The learner can explain when DMS, DataSync and Storage Gateway are appropriate for SAA-C03 architecture scenarios.
All chargeable migration compute and dependent cloud resources are removed before service roles, human credentials and local files.

tasks.title: Verify the training account and migration tools
tasks.goal: Confirm a disposable AWS account, AWS CLI and eu-west-2 before creating migration resources.
tasks.whyItMatters: DMS, DataSync and Storage Gateway solve different migration problems, so the lab begins with an explicit clean account and service-selection boundary.
tasks.examRelevance: AWS DMS, DataSync and Storage Gateway are all in-scope SAA-C03 services.

browserSteps.instruction: Sign in to the disposable AWS training account.
Confirm no fa-migration resources already exist.
Confirm the intended Region for every cloud resource in this lab is Europe (London) eu-west-2.
Do not create or use root access keys.
Root is used only for the one-time IAM bootstrap in Task 2 and final removal of the temporary IAM user in Task 16.

expectedResults: AWS CLI prints a version.
The training account is accessible.
No lab resource exists yet.

verificationChecks.text: AWS CLI runs successfully.
No fa-migration resource has been created.

tasks.title: Create the temporary migration IAM training user
tasks.goal: Use root only to create fa-migration-admin, one temporary access key and the complete migration lab policy.
tasks.whyItMatters: The training user needs permissions for network setup, DMS, DataSync, S3, Secrets Manager, SSM and a controlled set of service roles without using AdministratorAccess.
tasks.examRelevance: Migration design still depends on secure identities and service roles.
warnings: AWS DMS requires two fixed role names, dms-vpc-role and dms-cloudwatch-logs-role. Those names are service requirements and are the only intentional exceptions to the fa-migration naming prefix.

browserSteps.instruction: Sign in as the AWS root user only for this bootstrap task.
Replace the editor contents with the complete fa-migration-admin-policy JSON below.
Create exactly one access key for CLI use.
Copy the access key only to a temporary secure location.
Sign in as fa-migration-admin for routine browser work.

tasks.whyItMatters: The lab never stores a database password in a manuscript file; Secrets Manager generates it at runtime.
tasks.examRelevance: Secure migration automation separates configuration files from runtime credentials.

tasks.title: Create the DMS training VPC, two subnets and security groups
tasks.goal: Create a dedicated two-AZ VPC with public routing, a source-database security group and a DMS replication security group.
tasks.whyItMatters: A DMS replication subnet group needs subnets in at least two Availability Zones, while the replication instance must be able to reach the source endpoint.
tasks.examRelevance: DMS networking is part of migration planning: source/target reachability can be as important as the migration task itself.
warnings: The public subnets are used to keep this disposable lab self-contained without NAT Gateway cost; production database migrations commonly use private connectivity and stricter routing.

browserSteps.instruction: Create VPC fa-migration-vpc with IPv4 CIDR 10.70.0.0/16.
Create fa-migration-public-a in eu-west-2a with CIDR 10.70.1.0/24.
Create fa-migration-public-b in eu-west-2b with CIDR 10.70.2.0/24.
Enable auto-assign public IPv4 on both training subnets.
Create internet gateway fa-migration-igw and attach it to fa-migration-vpc.
Associate both public subnets with fa-migration-public-rt.
Create fa-migration-dms-sg in fa-migration-vpc with no inbound rules and default outbound allowed.
Add inbound MySQL/Aurora TCP 3306 to fa-migration-source-db-sg with source fa-migration-dms-sg.
Do not add SSH or internet-wide MySQL access.

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create VPC
cliBlocks.content: $VPC_ID = aws ec2 create-vpc --cidr-block 10.70.0.0/16 --tag-specifications "ResourceType=vpc,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=fa-migration-vpc},{Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration}]" --query Vpc.VpcId --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create subnet A
cliBlocks.content: $SUBNET_A_ID = aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id $VPC_ID --availability-zone eu-west-2a --cidr-block 10.70.1.0/24 --tag-specifications "ResourceType=subnet,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=fa-migration-public-a},{Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration}]" --query Subnet.SubnetId --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create subnet B
cliBlocks.content: $SUBNET_B_ID = aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id $VPC_ID --availability-zone eu-west-2b --cidr-block 10.70.2.0/24 --tag-specifications "ResourceType=subnet,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=fa-migration-public-b},{Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration}]" --query Subnet.SubnetId --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create IGW
cliBlocks.content: $IGW_ID = aws ec2 create-internet-gateway --tag-specifications "ResourceType=internet-gateway,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=fa-migration-igw},{Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration}]" --query InternetGateway.InternetGatewayId --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create route table
cliBlocks.content: $RT_ID = aws ec2 create-route-table --vpc-id $VPC_ID --tag-specifications "ResourceType=route-table,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=fa-migration-public-rt},{Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration}]" --query RouteTable.RouteTableId --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create DMS SG
cliBlocks.content: $DMS_SG_ID = aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name fa-migration-dms-sg --description "DMS replication instance" --vpc-id $VPC_ID --query GroupId --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create source DB SG
cliBlocks.content: $SOURCE_SG_ID = aws ec2 create-security-group --group-name fa-migration-source-db-sg --description "MariaDB source reachable only from DMS" --vpc-id $VPC_ID --query GroupId --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - allow DMS to MariaDB
cliBlocks.content: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id $SOURCE_SG_ID --protocol tcp --port 3306 --source-group $DMS_SG_ID --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

expectedResults: The VPC spans eu-west-2a and eu-west-2b.
Both subnets have internet routing.
Only fa-migration-dms-sg can reach source TCP 3306.

verificationChecks.text: No SSH ingress exists.
The source DB SG does not allow 3306 from 0.0.0.0/0.

tasks.title: Create the required DMS and source-instance IAM roles
tasks.goal: Create dms-vpc-role, dms-cloudwatch-logs-role and fa-migration roles for the source EC2 instance, Secrets Manager endpoint authentication and S3 target access.
tasks.whyItMatters: AWS DMS requires exact built-in role names for VPC and CloudWatch integration, while custom lab roles isolate secret and target-bucket permissions.
tasks.examRelevance: Migration services often assume service roles to reach VPC, logging, secrets and storage resources.

browserSteps.instruction: Create dms-vpc-role with trusted service dms.amazonaws.com.
Create dms-cloudwatch-logs-role with trusted service dms.amazonaws.com.
Create fa-migration-source-instance-role with trusted service ec2.amazonaws.com.
Add an inline policy named fa-migration-source-secret-read allowing secretsmanager:GetSecretValue only for arn:aws:secretsmanager:eu-west-2:<account>:secret:fa-migration/*.
Create instance profile fa-migration-source-instance-profile and add fa-migration-source-instance-role.
Create fa-migration-dms-secret-role with trust principal dms.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com.
Add an inline policy allowing secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on the fa-migration/mysql-source secret path.
Create fa-migration-dms-s3-role with trust principal dms.amazonaws.com.
Add S3 permissions for the derived DMS bucket and dms-output/*.
The complete trust and permission JSON used by CLI is supplied below.

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create dms-vpc-role
cliBlocks.content: aws iam create-role --role-name dms-vpc-role --assume-role-policy-document file://dms-trust.json --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - attach DMS VPC managed policy
PowerShell - create DMS logs role
cliBlocks.content: aws iam create-role --role-name dms-cloudwatch-logs-role --assume-role-policy-document file://dms-trust.json --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create source role
cliBlocks.content: aws iam create-role --role-name fa-migration-source-instance-role --assume-role-policy-document file://ec2-trust.json --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - add source role to profile
cliBlocks.content: aws iam add-role-to-instance-profile --instance-profile-name fa-migration-source-instance-profile --role-name fa-migration-source-instance-role --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - save regional DMS secret trust
PowerShell - create DMS secret role
cliBlocks.content: aws iam create-role --role-name fa-migration-dms-secret-role --assume-role-policy-document file://dms-secret-trust.json --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create DMS S3 role
cliBlocks.content: aws iam create-role --role-name fa-migration-dms-s3-role --assume-role-policy-document file://dms-trust.json --profile fa-migration-admin

expectedResults: Both exact AWS DMS required roles exist.
The source EC2 role can use SSM and read only the lab secret path.
The DMS secret role and DMS S3 role exist.

verificationChecks.text: dms-vpc-role has AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole.
dms-cloudwatch-logs-role has AmazonDMSCloudWatchLogsRole.
The source role is in fa-migration-source-instance-profile.

tasks.title: Launch and seed the self-managed MariaDB source without exposing its password
tasks.goal: Launch one Amazon Linux 2023 source instance, generate a Secrets Manager credential and seed three rows through Systems Manager.
tasks.whyItMatters: The source database demonstrates a real database endpoint while the credential remains generated and stored in Secrets Manager rather than in the manuscript.
tasks.examRelevance: A full-load-only MySQL-compatible source needs read privileges; CDC requires additional source configuration and replication privileges.
warnings: The EC2 source instance and its public IPv4 address can incur charges. Keep it only for the duration of the lab.

browserSteps.instruction: Launch one Amazon Linux 2023 instance named fa-migration-mysql-source.
Do not create or select a key pair.
Under Advanced details paste source-user-data.sh from Task 3.
Wait for EC2 status checks to pass and for the instance to appear in Systems Manager Managed nodes.
Create Other type of secret named fa-migration/mysql-source.
The CLI route below shows how to generate an alphanumeric runtime password and store username, password, port and host without printing the password.
After the secret exists, use Systems Manager Run Command with configure-source.sh to create migrationdb.customers and three harmless rows.
Do not display the secret value in the console after creation.

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - resolve latest AL2023 AMI
cliBlocks.content: $AMI_ID = aws ssm get-parameter --name /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64 --query Parameter.Value --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild subnet A
cliBlocks.content: $SUBNET_A_ID = aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=fa-migration-public-a --query "Subnets[0].SubnetId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild source SG
cliBlocks.content: $SOURCE_SG_ID = aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=group-name,Values=fa-migration-source-db-sg --query "SecurityGroups[0].GroupId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - launch source EC2
cliBlocks.content: $SOURCE_INSTANCE_ID = aws ec2 run-instances --image-id $AMI_ID --instance-type t3.micro --subnet-id $SUBNET_A_ID --security-group-ids $SOURCE_SG_ID --iam-instance-profile Name=fa-migration-source-instance-profile --associate-public-ip-address --user-data $SOURCE_USER_DATA --tag-specifications "ResourceType=instance,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=fa-migration-mysql-source},{Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration}]" --query "Instances[0].InstanceId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - wait for source running
cliBlocks.content: aws ec2 wait instance-status-ok --instance-ids $SOURCE_INSTANCE_ID --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - get source private IP
cliBlocks.content: $SOURCE_PRIVATE_IP = aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids $SOURCE_INSTANCE_ID --query "Reservations[0].Instances[0].PrivateIpAddress" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - generate runtime DB password
cliBlocks.content: $DB_PASSWORD = aws secretsmanager get-random-password --password-length 24 --exclude-punctuation --query RandomPassword --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create secret
cliBlocks.content: $DMS_SECRET_ARN = aws secretsmanager create-secret --name fa-migration/mysql-source --secret-string $SECRET_STRING --tags Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration --query ARN --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - attach source secret policy
cliBlocks.content: aws iam put-role-policy --role-name fa-migration-source-instance-role --policy-name fa-migration-source-secret-read --policy-document file://source-secret-policy.json --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - attach DMS secret policy
cliBlocks.content: aws iam put-role-policy --role-name fa-migration-dms-secret-role --policy-name fa-migration-dms-secret-read --policy-document file://source-secret-policy.json --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - send source configuration
cliBlocks.content: $COMMAND_ID = aws ssm send-command --instance-ids $SOURCE_INSTANCE_ID --document-name AWS-RunShellScript --parameters commands="$REMOTE_COMMAND" --query Command.CommandId --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

tasks.title: Create the DMS S3 target bucket and finish the DMS S3 role
tasks.goal: Create the deterministic S3 target bucket and grant fa-migration-dms-s3-role access only to that bucket.
tasks.whyItMatters: Using S3 as the DMS target keeps the database exercise small while still demonstrating endpoint roles and full-load output.
tasks.examRelevance: DMS supports Amazon S3 targets and requires a service access role with bucket permissions.

browserSteps.instruction: Create the bucket fa-migration-dms-<your recorded AWS account ID> in eu-west-2.
Add the inline S3 policy generated by the CLI route below.
The policy grants bucket listing/location plus object read/write/delete only in the DMS bucket.

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild account and DMS bucket
cliBlocks.content: $AWS_ACCOUNT_ID = aws sts get-caller-identity --profile fa-migration-admin --query Account --output text; $DMS_BUCKET = "fa-migration-dms-$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID"

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create DMS bucket
cliBlocks.content: aws s3api create-bucket --bucket $DMS_BUCKET --region eu-west-2 --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - attach DMS S3 policy
cliBlocks.content: aws iam put-role-policy --role-name fa-migration-dms-s3-role --policy-name fa-migration-dms-s3-access --policy-document file://dms-s3-policy.json --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - capture DMS S3 role ARN
cliBlocks.content: $DMS_S3_ROLE_ARN = aws iam get-role --role-name fa-migration-dms-s3-role --query Role.Arn --output text --profile fa-migration-admin

expectedResults: The DMS target bucket exists and remains private.
The DMS S3 role has access only to the derived training bucket.

verificationChecks.text: The bucket Region is eu-west-2.
No unrelated S3 bucket ARN appears in the DMS role policy.

tasks.title: Create the DMS subnet group and replication instance
tasks.goal: Create a two-AZ replication subnet group and one small Single-AZ DMS replication instance for the temporary full-load task.
tasks.whyItMatters: DMS processing is performed by the replication instance, and the subnet group controls where it can place network interfaces.
tasks.examRelevance: For production ongoing replication, Multi-AZ can improve availability; this short full-load lab uses Single-AZ to reduce temporary cost.
warnings: DMS replication instances incur charges while running; delete the instance as soon as the DMS and DataSync phases are complete.

browserSteps.instruction: High availability / Multi-AZ: disabled for this short full-load lab.
Publicly accessible: enabled for this disposable public-subnet lab.

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild subnet IDs
cliBlocks.content: $SUBNET_A_ID = aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=fa-migration-public-a --query "Subnets[0].SubnetId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin; $SUBNET_B_ID = aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=fa-migration-public-b --query "Subnets[0].SubnetId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create DMS subnet group
cliBlocks.content: aws dms create-replication-subnet-group --replication-subnet-group-identifier fa-migration-dms-subnets --replication-subnet-group-description "fa-migration two-AZ DMS subnets" --subnet-ids $SUBNET_A_ID $SUBNET_B_ID --tags Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild DMS SG
cliBlocks.content: $DMS_SG_ID = aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=group-name,Values=fa-migration-dms-sg --query "SecurityGroups[0].GroupId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create DMS replication instance
cliBlocks.content: aws dms create-replication-instance --replication-instance-identifier fa-migration-replication --replication-instance-class dms.t3.micro --allocated-storage 20 --no-multi-az --publicly-accessible --vpc-security-group-ids $DMS_SG_ID --replication-subnet-group-identifier fa-migration-dms-subnets --tags Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - wait for DMS available
cliBlocks.content: aws dms wait replication-instance-available --filters Name=replication-instance-id,Values=fa-migration-replication --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - capture replication ARN
cliBlocks.content: $REPL_ARN = aws dms describe-replication-instances --filters Name=replication-instance-id,Values=fa-migration-replication --query "ReplicationInstances[0].ReplicationInstanceArn" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

expectedResults: fa-migration-dms-subnets contains subnets in eu-west-2a and eu-west-2b.
fa-migration-replication reaches Available.
The replication instance uses fa-migration-dms-sg.

verificationChecks.text: The replication subnet group contains two Availability Zones.
The DMS instance is Single-AZ only for this temporary full-load exercise.

tasks.title: Create DMS endpoints, test connectivity and run the full-load task
tasks.goal: Create the Secrets Manager-authenticated MariaDB source endpoint, S3 target endpoint and full-load task for migrationdb.
tasks.whyItMatters: Endpoints describe connectivity; the task describes what tables move and whether the migration is full load, CDC or both.
tasks.examRelevance: SAA-C03 scenarios often distinguish one-time database migration from ongoing replication and low-downtime cutover.

browserSteps.instruction: Use AWS Secrets Manager for credentials.
Database name: migrationdb if the console provides a separate database field.
Create target endpoint fa-migration-s3-target using engine Amazon S3.
Test the source connection using fa-migration-replication and wait for Successful.
Test the target connection and wait for Successful.
Table mappings: include schema migrationdb and all tables.
Wait for Load complete / Stopped after the full load finishes.

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild role and secret ARNs
cliBlocks.content: $DMS_SECRET_ARN = aws secretsmanager describe-secret --secret-id fa-migration/mysql-source --query ARN --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin; $DMS_SECRET_ROLE_ARN = aws iam get-role --role-name fa-migration-dms-secret-role --query Role.Arn --output text --profile fa-migration-admin; $DMS_S3_ROLE_ARN = aws iam get-role --role-name fa-migration-dms-s3-role --query Role.Arn --output text --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create source endpoint
cliBlocks.content: aws dms create-endpoint --endpoint-identifier fa-migration-source-endpoint --endpoint-type source --engine-name mysql --database-name migrationdb --my-sql-settings SecretsManagerAccessRoleArn=$DMS_SECRET_ROLE_ARN,SecretsManagerSecretId=$DMS_SECRET_ARN --tags Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild DMS bucket
cliBlocks.content: $AWS_ACCOUNT_ID = aws sts get-caller-identity --profile fa-migration-admin --query Account --output text; $DMS_BUCKET = "fa-migration-dms-$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID"

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create S3 target endpoint
cliBlocks.content: aws dms create-endpoint --endpoint-identifier fa-migration-s3-target --endpoint-type target --engine-name s3 --s3-settings ServiceAccessRoleArn=$DMS_S3_ROLE_ARN,BucketFolder=dms-output,BucketName=$DMS_BUCKET,CompressionType=NONE --tags Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - capture endpoint ARNs
cliBlocks.content: $SOURCE_ENDPOINT_ARN = aws dms describe-endpoints --filters Name=endpoint-id,Values=fa-migration-source-endpoint --query "Endpoints[0].EndpointArn" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin; $TARGET_ENDPOINT_ARN = aws dms describe-endpoints --filters Name=endpoint-id,Values=fa-migration-s3-target --query "Endpoints[0].EndpointArn" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create DMS task
cliBlocks.content: $TASK_ARN = aws dms create-replication-task --replication-task-identifier fa-migration-full-load --source-endpoint-arn $SOURCE_ENDPOINT_ARN --target-endpoint-arn $TARGET_ENDPOINT_ARN --replication-instance-arn $REPL_ARN --migration-type full-load --table-mappings file://dms-table-mappings.json --replication-task-settings file://dms-task-settings.json --tags Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration --query ReplicationTask.ReplicationTaskArn --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - start DMS task
cliBlocks.content: aws dms start-replication-task --replication-task-arn $TASK_ARN --start-replication-task-type start-replication --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

expectedResults: Both endpoint connection tests become successful.
fa-migration-full-load completes its initial load.
Table statistics show the customers table was loaded.
Objects appear under s3://fa-migration-dms-<account-id>/dms-output/.

verificationChecks.text: The source endpoint uses Secrets Manager rather than clear-text endpoint credentials.
The task migration type is full-load.
At least three source rows are reported for migrationdb.customers.

tasks.title: Verify the migrated objects and compare full load with CDC
tasks.goal: Prove the three training rows reached S3 and explain when a production database migration would add CDC and Multi-AZ.
tasks.whyItMatters: A successful task is not enough; migration planning includes validating migrated data and deciding how to handle changes made during the migration window.
tasks.examRelevance: Full load moves existing data; full load plus CDC is the low-downtime pattern when ongoing source changes must be captured.

browserSteps.instruction: Find the migrationdb/customers output created by DMS.
Download or inspect the small CSV object and confirm Alpha Training, Bravo Training and Charlie Training are present.
Return to DMS and open fa-migration-full-load.
Open Table statistics and confirm migrationdb.customers completed.
Review the planning distinction: this lab uses full load because the source is static after seeding.
For a live production source that continues changing during migration, plan full load plus CDC and configure the source's change logs/permissions before cutover.
For long-running/ongoing replication, consider Multi-AZ for the DMS replication instance.

expectedResults: The DMS S3 output contains the three seeded customer rows.
Table statistics show the customers table completed.
The learner can explain why CDC is not enabled in this fixed-data lab.

verificationChecks.text: The S3 output contains Alpha Training, Bravo Training and Charlie Training.
No secret or database password appears in the S3 output.

tasks.title: Create the DataSync archive bucket and S3 access role
tasks.goal: Create a second S3 bucket and a dedicated DataSync role that can read the DMS bucket and write the archive bucket.
tasks.whyItMatters: DataSync separates transfer locations from the task that controls how and when objects move.
tasks.examRelevance: Use DataSync for managed high-speed data transfer between supported storage systems and AWS storage services.

browserSteps.instruction: Create fa-migration-archive-<account-id> in eu-west-2 with Block Public Access enabled.
Create role fa-migration-datasync-role trusted by datasync.amazonaws.com.
Add an inline policy that can list/read the DMS bucket and list/write/delete the archive bucket.
Do not give the role access to unrelated buckets.
The CLI route below builds the exact bucket ARNs from your verified account ID.

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild bucket names
cliBlocks.content: $AWS_ACCOUNT_ID = aws sts get-caller-identity --profile fa-migration-admin --query Account --output text; $DMS_BUCKET = "fa-migration-dms-$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID"; $ARCHIVE_BUCKET = "fa-migration-archive-$AWS_ACCOUNT_ID"

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create archive bucket
cliBlocks.content: aws s3api create-bucket --bucket $ARCHIVE_BUCKET --region eu-west-2 --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint=eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create DataSync role
cliBlocks.content: aws iam create-role --role-name fa-migration-datasync-role --assume-role-policy-document file://datasync-trust.json --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - attach DataSync policy
cliBlocks.content: aws iam put-role-policy --role-name fa-migration-datasync-role --policy-name fa-migration-datasync-s3-access --policy-document file://datasync-s3-policy.json --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - capture DataSync role ARN
cliBlocks.content: $DATASYNC_ROLE_ARN = aws iam get-role --role-name fa-migration-datasync-role --query Role.Arn --output text --profile fa-migration-admin

expectedResults: The archive bucket exists and is private.
fa-migration-datasync-role can read only the DMS bucket and write only the archive bucket.

verificationChecks.text: The DataSync role trust principal is datasync.amazonaws.com.
No unrelated bucket ARN appears in the policy.

tasks.title: Create DataSync locations, run the object transfer and verify it
tasks.goal: Create source/destination S3 locations, execute fa-migration-datasync-task and verify the DMS output is copied to the archive bucket.
tasks.whyItMatters: The task defines source, destination and transfer behavior independently from the buckets themselves.
tasks.examRelevance: DataSync is a managed transfer service; it is not a database change-capture engine and it does not replace DMS for transactional replication.
warnings: DataSync can incur transfer and S3 request charges; this lab transfers only a few tiny objects.

browserSteps.instruction: Create a second Amazon S3 location for fa-migration-archive-<account-id> with subdirectory /dms-copy and the same role.
Choose the DMS S3 location as source.
Choose the archive S3 location as destination.
Task mode: Enhanced if available; Basic is also valid for supported S3-to-S3 transfers, but use the mode displayed as recommended by the current console.
Keep verification enabled so DataSync verifies transferred data.
Wait until task execution Status is Success.
Open the archive bucket and verify the copied objects exist under dms-copy/.

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create source DataSync location
cliBlocks.content: $DS_SOURCE_ARN = aws datasync create-location-s3 --s3-bucket-arn "arn:aws:s3:::$DMS_BUCKET" --subdirectory /dms-output --s3-config BucketAccessRoleArn=$DATASYNC_ROLE_ARN --tags Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration --query LocationArn --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create destination DataSync location
cliBlocks.content: $DS_DEST_ARN = aws datasync create-location-s3 --s3-bucket-arn "arn:aws:s3:::$ARCHIVE_BUCKET" --subdirectory /dms-copy --s3-config BucketAccessRoleArn=$DATASYNC_ROLE_ARN --tags Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration --query LocationArn --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - create DataSync task
cliBlocks.content: $DS_TASK_ARN = aws datasync create-task --source-location-arn $DS_SOURCE_ARN --destination-location-arn $DS_DEST_ARN --name fa-migration-datasync-task --options VerifyMode=ONLY_FILES_TRANSFERRED,OverwriteMode=ALWAYS,PreserveDeletedFiles=PRESERVE --tags Key=FollowAlong,Value=fa-migration --query TaskArn --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - start DataSync task
cliBlocks.content: $DS_EXEC_ARN = aws datasync start-task-execution --task-arn $DS_TASK_ARN --query TaskExecutionArn --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

expectedResults: Both S3 locations exist.
fa-migration-datasync-task has a successful execution.
The archive bucket contains copies of the DMS output.

verificationChecks.text: DataSync execution status is SUCCESS.
The destination contains migrated customer data.
The original DMS bucket remains unchanged.

tasks.title: Build a cached-versus-stored Volume Gateway configuration plan
tasks.goal: Use the official Volume Gateway constraints and sizing guidance to complete the supplied configuration plan without launching an expensive gateway appliance.
tasks.whyItMatters: Storage Gateway solves hybrid storage access, not bulk database or object-copy migration; understanding the data-placement model is the important architecture decision.
tasks.examRelevance: Cached volumes keep primary data in Amazon S3 with hot data cached locally; stored volumes keep primary data local and asynchronously back it up to AWS.
warnings: A real EC2-hosted Volume Gateway normally requires an m5.xlarge-class host plus cache/upload-buffer EBS storage; this Follow Along deliberately plans that configuration instead of creating those chargeable resources.

browserSteps.instruction: For Gateway type choose Volume Gateway.
Review Cached volumes and Stored volumes.
Select Cached volumes for the planning exercise.
For Host platform choose Amazon EC2 and observe that this platform is available for cached volumes.
Do not launch the gateway instance in this lab; the production-style reference host is intentionally documented rather than provisioned to avoid m5.xlarge and large EBS lab charges.
Confirm the reference EC2 host is m5.xlarge based on the default EC2 Volume Gateway configuration.
Confirm a cached gateway needs separate cache and upload-buffer disks.
Confirm the plan uses 150 GiB upload buffer and 165 GiB cache.
Confirm the planned iSCSI cached volume is 100 GiB with target name fa-migration-volume.
Switch the wizard selection to Stored volumes and confirm Amazon EC2 is not an available stored-volume host platform.
Do not activate a gateway; close the wizard after comparing the choices.

Record the exam decision: cached volumes are appropriate when S3 is the primary store and frequently accessed blocks need local cache; stored volumes are appropriate when the full primary dataset must remain local while AWS receives asynchronous backups.

editableBlocks.title: volume-gateway-plan.json

expectedResults: The plan selects cached Volume Gateway for an EC2-hosted proof-of-concept.
The plan records 150 GiB upload buffer, 165 GiB cache and a 100 GiB iSCSI cached volume.
The learner can explain why a stored Volume Gateway cannot be hosted on Amazon EC2.

verificationChecks.text: No Storage Gateway appliance or EBS cache/buffer resource was created.
The volume plan is complete and contains no unresolved values.

tasks.title: Review the SAA-C03 migration and transfer decision points
tasks.goal: Turn the three service exercises into clear selection rules for database migration, data movement and hybrid storage.
tasks.whyItMatters: The exam commonly tests which migration service matches the data type and whether the requirement is one-time transfer, ongoing replication or ongoing hybrid access.
tasks.examRelevance: DMS, DataSync and Storage Gateway overlap around migration but solve different layers of the problem.

browserSteps.instruction: AWS DMS: choose it for database migration and replication between supported database endpoints.
DMS full load: moves the existing source data once.
DMS full load plus CDC: use it when source changes continue during migration and low-downtime cutover is required.
DMS replication instance: provides the compute that connects to source/target endpoints and performs replication work.
DMS endpoints: define connection details; this lab uses Secrets Manager for source authentication.
DataSync: choose it for managed high-speed transfer of files/objects between supported storage systems and AWS storage.
DataSync locations define source and destination; a DataSync task defines how the transfer runs.
DataSync is not a transactional database CDC engine.
Volume Gateway: choose it when applications need ongoing iSCSI block-storage access integrated with AWS, rather than a one-time copy.
Cached Volume Gateway: primary data lives in Amazon S3 and frequently accessed data is cached locally.
Stored Volume Gateway: primary data remains local and is asynchronously backed up to AWS.
Stored Volume Gateway cannot be deployed on Amazon EC2.
Exam trigger: migrate a live relational database with minimal downtime -> DMS with CDC where supported.
Exam trigger: move large file/object datasets to AWS repeatedly or on schedule -> DataSync.
Exam trigger: keep existing block-storage applications using iSCSI while integrating storage with AWS -> Volume Gateway.
Exam trap: Storage Gateway provides ongoing hybrid access; it is not simply a faster substitute for DataSync.

expectedResults: The learner can distinguish database replication, object/file transfer and hybrid block storage.
The DMS and DataSync exercises have visible successful outcomes.
The Volume Gateway plan is complete without a chargeable gateway appliance.

verificationChecks.text: The learner can choose DMS, DataSync or Volume Gateway from a requirement without relying on service-name clues.

tasks.title: Delete DMS, DataSync, S3 and source compute in reverse dependency order
tasks.goal: Remove migration tasks and endpoints before their roles, then delete copied objects, buckets, source EC2 and network dependencies.
tasks.whyItMatters: Credentials and service roles must remain available until cloud absence is verified.
tasks.examRelevance: Migration labs can leave costly replication compute or source instances running; cloud resources must be removed before identity cleanup.

browserSteps.instruction: Confirm no DataSync execution is running.
Open DMS and stop fa-migration-full-load only if it is still running.
Delete fa-migration-replication and wait until it disappears.
Delete all objects from the archive bucket, then delete the archive bucket.
Delete all objects from the DMS target bucket, then delete the DMS target bucket.
Terminate fa-migration-mysql-source and wait for Terminated.
Delete fa-migration/mysql-source from Secrets Manager using immediate deletion for this disposable lab only after DMS is gone.
Remove the explicit subnet associations from fa-migration-public-rt and delete the route table.
Verify no cloud resource from the lab remains before Task 16.

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - wait for DMS deletion
cliBlocks.content: aws dms wait replication-instance-deleted --filters Name=replication-instance-id,Values=fa-migration-replication --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - delete DMS subnet group

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - wait for source termination
cliBlocks.content: aws ec2 wait instance-terminated --instance-ids $SOURCE_INSTANCE_ID --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - delete secret immediately
cliBlocks.content: aws secretsmanager delete-secret --secret-id fa-migration/mysql-source --force-delete-without-recovery --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild SG IDs
cliBlocks.content: $SOURCE_SG_ID = aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=group-name,Values=fa-migration-source-db-sg --query "SecurityGroups[0].GroupId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin; $DMS_SG_ID = aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=group-name,Values=fa-migration-dms-sg --query "SecurityGroups[0].GroupId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild route/VPC IDs
cliBlocks.content: $VPC_ID = aws ec2 describe-vpcs --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=fa-migration-vpc --query "Vpcs[0].VpcId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin; $RT_ID = aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=fa-migration-public-rt --query "RouteTables[0].RouteTableId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin; $IGW_ID = aws ec2 describe-internet-gateways --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=fa-migration-igw --query "InternetGateways[0].InternetGatewayId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - list route associations
cliBlocks.content: $ASSOC_IDS = aws ec2 describe-route-tables --route-table-ids $RT_ID --query "RouteTables[0].Associations[?Main==`false`].RouteTableAssociationId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - remove associations
cliBlocks.content: foreach ($A in ($ASSOC_IDS -split "\s+")) { if ($A) { aws ec2 disassociate-route-table --association-id $A --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin } }

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - rebuild subnet IDs
cliBlocks.content: $SUBNET_A_ID = aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=fa-migration-public-a --query "Subnets[0].SubnetId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin; $SUBNET_B_ID = aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=fa-migration-public-b --query "Subnets[0].SubnetId" --output text --region eu-west-2 --profile fa-migration-admin

No DataSync task or location remains.

tasks.title: Delete migration service roles, temporary credentials and local files
tasks.goal: Remove all lab-created IAM roles/policies and the CLI profile only after cloud verification, then delete the local lab folder last.

tasks.examRelevance: Reverse dependency includes identities: workload first, service access next, human credentials and local files last.

browserSteps.instruction: Delete inline policies from fa-migration-datasync-role, fa-migration-dms-s3-role, fa-migration-dms-secret-role and fa-migration-source-instance-role.
Detach AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole from dms-vpc-role and delete dms-vpc-role.
Detach AmazonDMSCloudWatchLogsRole from dms-cloudwatch-logs-role and delete dms-cloudwatch-logs-role.
Sign in as root only now.

cliBlocks.title: PowerShell - remove source inline policy

fa-migration-admin and its access key/policy are deleted.

troubleshooting.title: Source EC2 never appears in Systems Manager
troubleshooting.likelyCause: The instance role, internet route, public IP or SSM Agent connectivity is missing.
troubleshooting.fix: Verify fa-migration-source-instance-profile contains the source role, the subnet has 0.0.0.0/0 to fa-migration-igw, and the instance has a public IPv4 address.

troubleshooting.title: MariaDB source setup command fails
troubleshooting.likelyCause: mariadb105-server is not installed yet, the secret is unreadable, or the source role lacks GetSecretValue.
troubleshooting.fix: Check the SSM command output, confirm user-data completed, and verify fa-migration-source-secret-read references the exact secret ARN.

troubleshooting.title: DMS source endpoint connection test fails
troubleshooting.likelyCause: TCP 3306 is blocked, the secret host is wrong, MariaDB is not running, or the DMS user was not created.
troubleshooting.fix: Verify the source secret host matches the source private IP, fa-migration-source-db-sg allows 3306 from fa-migration-dms-sg, and the SSM setup command succeeded.

troubleshooting.title: DMS target endpoint connection test fails
troubleshooting.likelyCause: fa-migration-dms-s3-role cannot access the derived bucket or the target endpoint uses the wrong bucket name.
troubleshooting.fix: Compare the role's inline bucket ARN with DMS_BUCKET and verify the bucket exists in eu-west-2.

troubleshooting.title: DMS full load has zero rows
troubleshooting.likelyCause: The table mapping does not match migrationdb/customers or the source setup did not seed the table.
troubleshooting.fix: Confirm dms-table-mappings.json selects schema migrationdb and table %, then inspect the source setup SSM command output.

troubleshooting.title: DataSync location creation is denied
troubleshooting.likelyCause: The DataSync role trust or S3 policy does not permit the requested bucket.
troubleshooting.fix: Confirm the role trusts datasync.amazonaws.com and contains the exact derived DMS and archive bucket ARNs.

troubleshooting.title: DataSync task finishes but destination is empty
troubleshooting.likelyCause: The source subdirectory does not match the DMS output prefix.
troubleshooting.fix: List the DMS bucket recursively and confirm the source location points to /dms-output.

troubleshooting.title: DMS replication instance cannot be deleted
troubleshooting.likelyCause: A replication task or endpoint connection still references it.
troubleshooting.fix: Delete the DMS task first, then the endpoints, then retry replication-instance deletion.

troubleshooting.title: VPC security group cannot be deleted
troubleshooting.likelyCause: A DMS or EC2 network interface is still present.
troubleshooting.fix: Wait until the replication instance and source EC2 instance are fully deleted before retrying only the exact fa-migration security group.
